A '''clone trooper pilot''' served the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Siege of Mandalore]]<ref name="Old Friends Not Forgotten" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> As the battle began, the [[clone trooper pilot|pilot]] transported a number of [[clone trooper]]s of the [[332nd Company]] to the [[city]] of [[Sundari]] on the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]] to assist the [[Mandalore resistance]] in taking back the city from the former [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], flying a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport|LAAT gunship]]. Before the [[pilot]]'s [[Space gunship|gunship]] could reach Sundari, it was hit and suffered damage, and the [[pilot]] was unable to eject. The former [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who was leading the forces of the 332nd, jumped onto the falling [[Gunship|craft]] and rescued the pilot, who ejected from the [[Starship|ship]] after thanking her.<ref name="Old Friends Not Forgotten" />

The pilot wore clone trooper pilot armor with the updated rig. The armor was decorated with [[Color|green]] markings.<ref name="Old Friends Not Forgotten" />
